generators.carrier: finite fermionic Fock space Lambda(C^N) over lattice sites
finite Hilbert space tensor of bosonic truncated sites and fermionic Fock space; Q = sum_i (p_i + i W'_i) c_i type, to be specified

relations.statement: H = {Q, Q^dagger}, hence H >= 0 on finite Hilbert space; for N=1 with self-adjoint Q, H = Q^2
relations.hypotheses: Q specified explicitly; nilpotency Q^2=0 is not assumed for the Hermitian case; needs a concrete lattice Q

lemmas.statement: If Q is a self-adjoint operator on a finite-dimensional Hilbert space and H := Q^2, then H >= 0 and {Q,Q}=2H.
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem l_H_nonneg {n : Nat} (Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Complex) (hQ : Q.conjTranspose = Q) : (Q.conjTranspose * Q).PosSemidef := by sorry

near_misses.claim: Naive lattice derivative discretization gives full N=1 algebra with Q^2 = H exactly
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: Leibniz rule fails on lattice, so Q^2 yields translation only up to the lattice-difference correction; the exact algebra holds only for a subalgebra

near_misses.claim: Pairing of nonzero levels follows from H>=0 alone
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: Pairing requires an operator (-1)^F anticommuting with Q and a specified Q; H>=0 alone does not give it
